# Unstuck — workaroundtraffic.com

> The home of *Unstuck: How To Work Around Traffic When Government Won't Really Help* by Mai G. Mislang, and the Unstuck Philippines Flexible Work Pilot for employers. The core argument: Metro Manila's traffic crisis is not only a government failure — it is a corporate policy failure, and organizations can reduce the human cost of the commute right now through alternative work arrangements.

## The book
- **Title:** Unstuck: How To Work Around Traffic When Government Won't Really Help
- **Author:** Mai G. Mislang
- **For:** HR and people leaders, executives, and knowledge workers in congested cities
- **Thesis:** The daily commute imposes a "bandwidth tax" — the time and cognitive energy lost before and after work. The fix does not start with government; it starts with the policy decisions organizations make about where and how people work.
- **Buy:** Kindle on Amazon — https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GYHN6D1D (paperback includes nine appendices for HR leaders)

## The free tool
- **Bandwidth Tax Calculator** (on the homepage): estimates what a person's commute costs in free hours per week and per year. Free, no sign-up.

## For employers — the Flexible Work Pilot
- **Page:** https://workaroundtraffic.com/program.html
- **What it is:** A guided program that helps Philippine employers design, cost, and run a real flexible-work pilot in 90 days.
- **Who it is for:** HR and people leaders, CEOs and executives, sustainability teams.
- **Participants leave with:** a role-by-role presence map, a cost-of-commute business case, a 90-day pilot plan, and a policy template aligned with the Telecommuting Act (RA 11165).
- **Formats:** Founding Cohort (three full-day sessions, 10 seats) and In-house Workshop (delivered to a single company). Pricing to be announced; join the waitlist to be told first.
